GUEST SPEAKER · 2026

Mohamed
AbdelGawad

AI & Automation Software Tech Lead & Trainer

Mohamed AbdelGawad is an AI & Automation Software Tech Lead and Trainer with nearly six years of experience at a multinational telecommunications company, including four years focused on automation.

He has delivered more than 50 automation projects and trained over 70 learners from Egypt and Saudi Arabia.

His work focuses on turning real-world business challenges into practical automation solutions, helping individuals and organizations use AI and automation to work smarter.

CONNECT THE DOTS

FROM AI TO AUTOMATION

Don't just use tools. Learn how to connect them. AI Automation combines AI capabilities with workflows that handle repeatable tasks with less manual effort.

01

TRIGGER

An event starts the workflow.

02

AI PROCESSING

AI interprets or organizes information.

03

ACTION

A connected app performs a task.

04

RESULT

The output is ready for you.

Example 01 · Email to spreadsheet

New email→AI analyzes it→Extract details→Save to Sheets

Example 02 · Student welcome flow

Form response→Collect interests→Categorize→Send welcome
